notes: No approve/decline/commit tool — approval stays behind a security key in Review UI.
Annotations are opt-in true only (Chrome webmcp-skills).

tools.name: list_pending_requests
tools.description: Lists items waiting on a person in the ClawQL Review queue. Use when the user asks what is pending, waiting, or needs approval.

tools.name: get_request_detail
tools.description: Returns the exact fields and digest for one pending request. Use when reviewing what would change before a person approves.

tools.name: search_audit_log
tools.description: Searches recent audit entries by actor, action, or outcome. Use when investigating what agents or people did.

tools.name: list_approval_rules
tools.description: Lists who must approve which agent writes and whether a security key is required. Use when explaining or drafting approval policy.

tools.name: draft_approval_rule
tools.description: Builds a non-persisted approval-rule draft for a person to review. Use when proposing policy wording; never claims the rule is saved.

tools.name: open_review_request
tools.description: Navigates to the Review UI so a person can approve with their security key. Use when the user is ready to hand off; this does not approve.
